subject: Re: Isolation assertion, PT results and action plan
messages:
From: Luis Morales <luis.morales@acmecorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: secops@acmecorp.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test report + environment assurances for Private deployment

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. As part of our procurement and security review we need: 1) the most recent penetration test report covering the Private deployment offering (or a summary if the full report is under NDA), 2) explicit boundary assumptions for customer VPC/private deployments (what you consider in/out of scope for Redwood-managed services vs customer-managed VPC components), and 3) a short statement of current remediation status for any critical or high findings that could impact data egress or tenant isolation.

Our security team is particularly focused on egress controls from the inference enclave, cross-tenant data leakage mitigations, and how you validate tenant isolation in customer VPCs. Please also include any evidence artifacts you can share (segmentation diagrams, patching timelines, remediation trackers). If anything is restricted by NDA, indicate what we can expect to see once our legal executes the standard mutual NDA.

Target timeline: we need this material for our security review by Friday 12/11. Can you confirm whether that is feasible and what you will be able to share?

Thanks,
Luis Morales
Senior Security Manager
FinServ Solutions

Attachment: request-checklist.txt (text/plain)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Luis Morales <luis.morales@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report + environment assurances for Private deployment

Hi Luis — thanks for the clear list. We can meet the 12/11 timeline for a redacted set of artifacts and an isolation assertion document; a few clarifying points so we can package exactly what you need: 

- Which Private deployment model are you evaluating? (VPC peered with Redwood control plane, or full customer-hosted control plane/air-gapped option?)
- For egress controls: do you need packet captures/flow logs or is configuration-level evidence (egress ACLs, NAT gateway configs, gateway firewall rules) sufficient?
- Any formal signing authority on your NDA so we can route the full PT report if required?

We have a segmentation diagram and a remediation tracker I can share. I will attach an internal network segmentation drawing and provide a one-page summary of assumptions (what Redwood considers within our managed enclave vs customer-managed components). If you confirm the deployment variant and the preferred evidence types by EOD tomorrow we will assemble: (a) redacted PT summary (high/critical findings only), (b) isolation assertion statement, (c) remediation tracker with ETA for outstanding items, (d) segmentation diagram.

Attaching: network-segmentation-drawing.pdf (application/pdf) — this is a high-level map of the customer VPC <> Redwood enclave boundary.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report + environment assurances for Private deployment

Neha — copying Aditya for context.

Please include the following deliverables in the packet to FinServ:

1) PT summary: redacted executive summary that lists scope, test dates, and high/critical findings with status; do not include proof-of-concept exploit code.
2) Isolation assertion: a one-page statement signed by Security that enumerates boundary assumptions (network entities Redwood manages vs customer-managed), expected controls (KV cache isolation, per-tenant memory allocation, network egress filtering), and test methods used to validate.
3) Remediation tracker: CSV/XLSX with finding ID, severity, owner, mitigation applied, evidence link, and ETA.

I've attached the internal PT summary from Nov 2026 (redacted) and a remediation tracker template you can populate with dates. Use the standard language from our compliance pack for KV cache isolation and tenant routing.

On the timeline: aim to send the packet as a single zipped payload to Luis on 12/10 EOD so they have time to review before their 12/11 cutoff. If we need the full report under NDA, Legal can coordinate — we should indicate that in the packet and provide a DocuSign link.

Thanks — brief inline draft for the isolation assertion is below (feel free to iterate):

---
Isolation Assertion (draft)
Redwood Inference maintains a strict boundary between customer VPCs and the Redwood-managed inference enclave. Customer VPCs are configured to route inference traffic through an egress gateway controlled by the customer; Redwood enforces strict host-level process isolation, per-tenant model artifact directories, and cryptographic keys are tenant-scoped. Validation includes automated inter-tenant fuzz tests, KV cache isolation checks, and scheduled internal red-team assessments. Any findings that could enable cross-tenant data exposure are triaged as high priority with an SLA of 14 days for mitigation and 30 days for validation evidence.
---

Attach: pt-summary-2026-11.pdf (application/pdf), remediation-tracker.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Markus Klein
Head of Product Security
Redwood Inference
From: Luis Morales <luis.morales@acmecorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: secops@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report + environment assurances for Private deployment

Neha / Markus — thanks, that helps. A couple quick asks before we close our review: 

- Can you confirm whether the PT summary includes testing of egress mediation (NAT/firewall) from the inference enclave in the VPC-peered model, or whether that is considered out-of-scope because egress is customer-managed?
- For the remediation tracker, please include an ETA column (we need concrete dates) and evidence links (flow logs or firewall rule snapshots) for any finding listed as high/critical.
- If you have a one-page signed isolation assertion, please include a contact for escalation and the name/title of the signer.

We can accept redacted PoC details but need the reproduction steps abstracted enough to validate remediation. If the full report requires a mutual NDA, please send the DocuSign link and we'll route it through Legal — otherwise we can proceed with the redacted packet.

I'll expect the packet by 12/10 EOD PST so our security review can complete on 12/11. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Luis Morales
Senior Security Manager
FinServ Solutions
